title: Privacy
body:
A general privacy policy for Edmonton Home Services. It isn't a substitute for legal advice — have a lawyer review it before relying on it for compliance.

What this site is

Edmonton Home Services is a static site. It doesn't run user accounts, and it doesn't set tracking or advertising cookies.

Information we collect

When you use the Contact or Submit Your Business forms, we collect the information you provide — typically your name, email, phone number, and message. That's used only to respond to you or review your submission.

How your information is handled

  • Form submissions are processed by Netlify Forms, our form-hosting provider.
  • Fonts are loaded from Google Fonts, which may log the request (IP address, browser) the way any web request does.
  • Your theme preference (light or dark) is stored locally in your browser and never sent to us.

We don't sell or share your information with third parties beyond what's needed to operate the site, as described above.

Outbound links

Listings link to third-party business websites. Once you leave this site, their own privacy practices apply.

Your rights

You can ask us to access, correct, or delete information you've submitted by contacting us below.

Changes

We may update this policy as the site changes.

Contact

Questions about this policy? Reach us at info@edmontonhomeservices.com.
